days.title: Historical Forges and Information
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Wentsteinhammer
stops.detail: As the name Hammerbach already suggests, several water-driven hammer mills were built along this stream; within the nature park, the Wentsteinhammer was restored and serves as a demonstration forge.

stops.name: Treffenguthammer
stops.detail: The Treffenguthammer is also one of the few preserved hammer mills along the Hammerbach.

stops.name: Naturparkinformationszentrum
stops.detail: The nature park information center is located in the tourist office on the village square of Hollenstein an der Ybbs

days.title: Forest Shelters and Mountain Huts
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Promau
stops.detail: Thematic trails were created in the nature park and a bark hut – a shelter for lumberjacks made of tree bark and a few wooden poles – was built in Promau.

stops.name: Kitzhütte
stops.detail: Located at 1,280 m above sea level, the managed Kitzhütte offers overnight accommodation on mattress camps for up to 25 people (open from May 25th to October 31st).
